charts.title: PRs merged this week
charts.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pull_requests WHERE merged_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND tenant = $1

charts.title: Deployments this month
charts.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM deployments WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) AND tenant = $1

charts.title: Mean time to merge (hours)
charts.sql: SELECT avg(extract(epoch FROM (merged_at - created_at)) / 3600) FROM pull_requests WHERE tenant = $1 AND merged_at IS NOT NULL

charts.title: Open opportunities by stage
charts.sql: SELECT stage, count(*) FROM opportunities WHERE tenant = $1 AND status = 'open' GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage

charts.title: Pipeline value (USD)
charts.sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_usd), 0) FROM opportunities WHERE tenant = $1 AND status = 'open'

charts.title: Revenue by month
charts.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', booked_at) AS month, sum(amount_usd) FROM invoices WHERE tenant = $1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

charts.title: Top customers by ARR
charts.sql: SELECT customer_id, sum(arr_usd) AS arr FROM contracts WHERE tenant = $1 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY arr DESC LIMIT 10

charts.title: Funnel conversion by step
charts.sql: SELECT step, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS users FROM funnel_events WHERE tenant = $1 GROUP BY step ORDER BY step

charts.title: Campaign click-through rate
charts.sql: SELECT campaign_id, sum(clicks)::float / nullif(sum(impressions), 0) AS ctr FROM ad_metrics WHERE tenant = $1 GROUP BY campaign_id ORDER BY ctr DESC

charts.title: Average NPS score
charts.sql: SELECT avg(score) FROM survey_responses WHERE tenant = $1 AND survey_id = 'cust-sat-2025'

charts.title: Response volume by week
charts.sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', submitted_at) AS week, count(*) FROM survey_responses WHERE tenant = $1 AND survey_id = 'cust-sat-2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
